definition: Manus (meaning hand in Latin) is an autonomous artificial intelligence agent developed by Butterfly Effect, a company founded in China and based in Singapore.
details: Manus (meaning hand in Latin) is an autonomous artificial intelligence agent developed by Butterfly Effect, a company founded in China and based in Singapore.

explainer.lead: Manus (Latin for hand) is an autonomous AI agent developed by Butterfly Effect, a company founded in China and based in Singapore. It matters as an example of the autonomous-agent product category.

tiers.eli5: It is a software helper that is meant to carry out tasks on its own rather than only answering one question at a time.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers evaluate such agents on how reliably they complete multi-step tasks unsupervised. The pitfall with autonomous agents generally is verifying that actions taken without step-by-step supervision are correct.
tiers.paperLevel: Manus is an autonomous artificial intelligence agent developed by Butterfly Effect, a company founded in China and based in Singapore. The name means hand in Latin.

explainer.example: A user hands an agent a task to execute end to end, and it proceeds autonomously rather than waiting on each step.
